description: This source file implements the DHCPv4 client API for device configuration, including management of DHCP client instances, retrieval of interface, DNS, and router information, and validation of IP addresses.

classes.name: hostIf_DHCPv4Client
classes.description: Class managing DHCPv4 client configuration and state, including instance management, data retrieval, and IP validation.

methods.name: get_Device_DHCPv4_Client_InterfaceReference
methods.description: Retrieves the interface reference used by the DHCPv4 client.

methods.name: get_Device_DHCPv4_Client_DnsServer
methods.description: Retrieves the DNS server addresses used by the DHCPv4 client.

methods.name: get_Device_DHCPv4_Client_IPRouters
methods.description: Retrieves the IP routers associated with the DHCPv4 client.

methods.name: get_Device_DHCPv4_ClientNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Gets the number of DHCPv4 client entries (default is 1).

methods.name: isValidIPAddr
methods.description: Validates whether a given string is a valid IPv4 address.

methods.name: getInterfaceName
methods.description: Retrieves the network interface name associated with the device ID.
